regions.today: It will be dry today with sunny spells. Cloud will increase during the afternoon with outbreaks of rain developing towards the evening in southern areas of the Province with localised flooding possible. Eastern and northern parts of Leinster will remain dry until after dark. Highs of 13 to 15 degrees with moderate southeasterly winds.
regions.tonight: Cloudy, with the rain spreading to all areas early in the night. The rain will be persistent and may turn heavy as the night progresses, with some localised flooding possible, especially on the East Coast. Lows of 5 to 9 degrees with moderate southeasterly winds veering northwesterly and increasing fresh to strong and gusty overnight.
regions.tomorrow: It will be cloudy and wet to start tomorrow with further outbreaks of rain, heavy at times. Localised flooding is still possible in eastern counties early in the morning. The rain will clear early in the afternoon with sunny spells and isolated showers following. Highs of 10 to 12 degrees with fresh and gusty westerly winds gradually easing throughout the day.
